question: Typed picker answers (docs/ROSTER.md HR-173, ruled: a free-text answer is the maintainer's word). The SDD plan's ruling-capture row asked that a typed answer matching no option be re-asked once before the run acts. Which stands?

options.label: Keep HR-173 (Recommended)
options.consequence: A typed answer is acted on as given; re-ask only when the reply does not answer (a question back, or fits neither an option nor the row's typed form)

options.label: Re-ask once
options.consequence: Amend HR-173: any typed answer that matches no option is re-asked once; the run acts on the second answer
